## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

MMPI-CHN/MMPI-CHN.github.io.description: MMPI-2 Chinese Test - Completely Free - With Results
MMPI-CHN/MMPI-CHN.github.io.body:
# MMPI-CHN

A free MMPI-2 Chinese test project launched in February 2023. The entire site is static pages, no registration required, and answering, scoring, and results display can be completed directly in the browser.

**Online Use** → <https://mmpi-chn.github.io/>

---

## What Is This

- All **567 questions** of MMPI-2, with Chinese-English comparison; also supports short form mode with only the first 370 questions
- Output raw scores, K-corrected scores, T scores, two personality profile charts, basic interpretations, critical items, and original responses
- The two profile charts and 13 basic interpretation tables use **approximate Chinese T scores** calculated based on Chinese sample statistics
- Complete technical tables retain US lookup T scores for professionals to verify the entire scoring chain
- Chart.js is released with the repository; the core results page does not depend on charting CDN

## What This Is Not

**This is not equivalent to the official MMPI-2 and cannot be used for diagnosis.** There are three main boundaries:

1. **Different translation.** This project uses a self-compiled Chinese translation, which differs from the official "MMPI-2 Simplified Chinese Version". The Chinese norms cited in this project are established from the official translation; whether the questions are equivalent cannot be confirmed, and the resulting deviations cannot be quantified.
2. **Conversion is still approximate.** The complete raw score frequency distribution of the Chinese norms and the raw score → T score conversion table have not been published. This project uses published means and standard deviations to correct location and dispersion, but still adopts the distribution shape of American consistent T scores, and therefore cannot claim to be the official Chinese norms lookup values.
3. **Norms have temporal boundaries.** The Chinese MMPI-2 national norms used in this project were established in the 1990s, with sample structure benchmarked against the 1990 Fourth National Census. As of September 2026, we have not found an officially published Chinese MMPI-2 national re-norming to replace it; the University of Minnesota Press [current translation directory](https://www.upress.umn.edu/test-division/translations/) still lists Chinese MMPI-2, and Chinese MMPI-3 is still under development. Therefore, it is the officially confirmed Chinese MMPI-2 basis that the project can currently verify, but it cannot correct for population changes over the more than thirty years since.

The traditional American 567-question MMPI-2 is also still based on a sample of 2,600 people collected in the late 1980s. The 2001 manual revision, 2003 non-gender-specific scoring scheme, and subsequent scale updates did not re-sample contemporary national samples; the [current MMPI-2 product information](https://www.pearsonassessments.com/en-us/Store/Professional-Assessments/Personality-%26-Biopsychosocial/Minnesota-Multiphasic-Personality-Inventory-2/p/100000461) still explicitly lists this set of norms. Ooxygen7/SnowAPI.body:
# SnowAPI

**Unified API gateway, billing platform, and operations console for multi-model services.**

Converge different vendors, protocols, and billing methods into a set of stable, clear, and operable infrastructure.

[Online Console](https://api.unsnow.org) · [Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Feature Overview](#feature-overview) · [Deployment Guide](#production-deployment) · [Contribute](#contribute)

---

## What is SnowAPI

SnowAPI is an all-in-one platform designed for AI model aggregation, distribution, and commercialization. It connects different upstream vendors behind a unified entry point, providing applications with common protocols such as OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages. It simultaneously covers channel scheduling, model pricing, quota settlement, subscription benefits, access control, log auditing, and operations management.

The project includes a complete Go backend, React console, database models, protocol conversion layer, Docker builds, and production deployment examples. It can be used for personal model gateways, team-shared services, or user-facing API platforms.

## Feature Overview

### Unified Model Gateway

- Centrally manage multiple upstream vendors, channels, model mappings, and API credentials.
- Support protocol endpoints such as `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, and `/v1/messages`.
- Select actual endpoints and interface types by model, and complete request conversion between compatible protocols.
- Models with the same name can form scheduling pools across channels, supporting priority, weight, automatic failover, and load balancing.
- Cover streaming responses, usage statistics, error mapping, and upstream response auditing.

### Minimal Operations Mode

- Quickly establish model services through Base URL, API Key, interface type, and upstream model name.
- Independently configure display name, icon, user group, input price, output price, and cache input price for each model.
- Directly select from the model list obtained from upstream without repeated entry across multiple backend modules.
- Preserve complete channel mode, adapting to more complex vendor strategies and operations scenarios.

### Users, Subscriptions, and Billing

- Unified management of users, API keys, quotas, groups, and access permissions.
- Support billing by token or by request, recording input, output, cache, and total consumption.
- Support periodic quotas, 5-hour rolling windows, package validity periods, and subscription upgrades.
- Support redemption code quotas and benefit distribution, as well as subscription-driven user group upgrades.
- Support LinuxDO credit balance top-up and order status callbacks.

### Operations and Security

- Unified retrieval of usage logs, billing logs, system logs, and admin operations.
- Visualize model health, success rate, request volume, token consumption, and hourly trends.
- IP auditing can identify overlapping calls from multiple countries and ASNs in a short time, and execute automatic or manual blocking.
- Support invitation code registration, Cloudflare Turnstile, OAuth, permission control, and rate limiting.

SuperGness/codey.body:
# Codey

Codey is an enhancement launcher for the Codex desktop client, centrally managing model routes, accounts, sessions, and extensions, and providing usage analytics and task notifications.

## Key Features

- Routes and Models: Manage official and third-party routes, configure proxies, sync account-available models, drag to adjust routes and model order, switch models and thinking strength in tasks; when local routing is enabled, exhausting official quotas will not prevent switching to third-party routes.
- Official Accounts: Manage multiple ChatGPT accounts, customize gateway addresses, separately view quotas and reset times, and switch between them in the same conversation.
- Requests and Usage: Query request duration, tokens, and errors, analyze usage trends, model distribution, and cost estimates.
- Session Management: View task status, import and export sessions, delete specific turns and restore backups.
- Extension Management: Manage MCP, Skill, and trusted Codey plugins, support configuration, enable/disable, import/export, and plugin log viewing and cleanup.
- Plugin Routes: After enabling a plugin that declares route capabilities, add a route; enter the key in the route; when disabling, delete routes without filled keys, routes with filled keys will be retained.
- Task Count: Plugins call `codey://getTasks` through `codey.appserver.v1` to query the number of currently running and failed tasks; no active statistics when not called.
- Page Enhancement: Improve plugin marketplace and common session operations, support featured plugin offline recovery.
- Prompt Optimization: One-click optimization of input content, results can be further edited.
- Model Division of Labor: Assign models to sub-agent roles, session naming, message submission, and other auxiliary tasks.
- File Tools: Optionally enable FastCtx, read, search files, and bulk replace content.
- Task Notifications: Receive completion, failure, and intervention-awaiting notifications via Feishu, WeChat Work, Telegram, ntfy, or WeChat ClawBot.
- Diagnostics and Updates: Check and fix configuration, recover disconnections, clean up diagnostic logs, provide pet optimization, rendering diagnostics, and automatic update checks.
- Release Management: Manage versions, update logs, device machine IDs, and full, whitelist-based, and targeted releases in a separate Cloudflare console.

## Usage and Precautions

Opening Codey will automatically launch Codex; click the Codey button at the bottom of the left icon bar to enter the console; whether a restart is needed is determined by the interface prompt.

- Only clearly identifiable Codex desktop clients are supported; launching may restart the selected client; please end any running tasks first; when multiple versions coexist, explicit selection is required.
- Official routes require adding official accounts; the default account determines the client's login identity; each route uses its own account.
- Third-party capabilities and cross-route session compatibility depend on the service provider and Codex version; custom context cannot expand service provider capacity.
- Quotas and fees are estimates and do not represent actual deductions or official limits.
- Installation packages and native plugins should only be from trusted sources; native plugins have the same system permissions as Codey; Codey does not modify client security settings; if integration fails, native launch will be attempted after confirmation cleanup.
- After disabling automatic update checks, if Codex upgrade causes Codey to fail to launch, manual download of the new version of Codey is required.

# 🪪 Hong Kong Immigration Department Appointment Quota Monitoring

Real-time tracking of Hong Kong Immigration Department's **ID replacement** appointment quotas, with automatic notifications via **Feishu group + Feishu direct messages** when new quotas are released.

---

## 📱 Method 1: Join Feishu Group (Recommended)

The bot automatically pushes quota changes, **instant message delivery**, join and use immediately, no configuration needed.

> 📖 **[Group Information & How to Join](https://scn7uo58gnuo.feishu.cn/wiki/QSFlwcMBmil7sGkZRBTcAWqwnCf)** (Multiple group options, automatic distribution when groups are full)

### 💬 Method 2: Feishu Direct Message Subscription

If you don't want to join a group, you can also **filter by date**, receiving notifications only for dates you're interested in:

1. [Direct message the bot "HKID Quota Auto Monitoring"](https://applink.feishu.cn/T98uc8RbxI8c) (Send any message to trigger)
2. The bot will reply with an interactive card supporting:
   - 📅 **Subscribe to Specific Dates** — Only track the date you booked
   - 🔔 **Subscribe to All Dates** — Get notified for all quota releases
   - 📊 **View / Modify / Cancel Subscription**
3. You can also reply with dates for one-click subscription, e.g., `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Supports three filtering modes:
- 📅 **By Date** — View specific dates only, across all offices
- 🏢 **By Office** — View specific office only, across all dates
- 🎯 **By Date + Office** — Exact match

> 💡 Direct message bot has 1-2 second delay, join the group if you're in a hurry.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status at all offices across Hong Kong
- 📈 Quota release pattern heatmap, visualization of release frequency by time period
- 📖 Includes phone appointment tutorial
- 🔧 Built-in admin panel supporting subscriber management, statistics overview, dual-channel broadcast

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quotas are detected, notifications are pushed in the following order:

> **Group Broadcast** (multiple groups in parallel) → **Direct Message DM** (parallel, only to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu groups and direct messages arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy & Security

- Feishu user data encrypted with **AES-256-GCM encryption**, not readable in repository
- Only reads quota data **publicly released** by the Immigration Department
- ⚠️ Disclaimer: This system is a third-party open-source tool, not an official service of the Hong Kong Immigration Department. Please refer to the official website for accurate information.

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors the smart ID card appointment quotas across six major immigration registration offices of the Hong Kong Immigration Department, with detection approximately every 2 minutes. When quotas are released, subscribers are notified via email/Feishu groups. **Third-party public welfare tool, not an official Immigration Department service; only provides monitoring and reminders, does not engage in any quota-grabbing or appointment-substituting services.**

## Dashboard Entrance

- **Recommended (stable direct connection from mainland)**: https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (Mainland network connection to github.io is intermittent; jsDelivr/raw direct links with nosniff headers will only display source code, do not use as webpage entrance)
- For full experience without VPN on mainland China, use **Email Subscription + Feishu Groups** — notification path has direct domestic connections throughout, releases pushed to phone immediately, dashboard is only supplementary

## How It Works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                                  │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                                  │  ├─ Fetch Immigration Department public quota API (read-only, one request per cycle)
                                  │  ├─ Diff with previous snapshot → release event
                                  │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                                  ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refresh every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements Compared to Similar Tools

- **Mobile-first**: Dates scroll vertically in rows, all 6 offices fit on one screen, no need for horizontal table dragging
- **Colorblind-friendly**: Status cell colors + text dual-channel (available/limited/full)

# MoviePilot-V3 Service Management Panel (Windows)

MoviePilot v3 one-click management panel built on **.NET Framework 4.8**: system tray icon + visual interface, one-click startup/stop/restart of all services (nginx frontend + Python backend), automatically downloads portable runtime environment on first use, no manual command line configuration required.
> For detailed content including runtime requirements, source code compilation, configuration instructions (config\app.ini), command line usage, patch package instructions, upgrade mechanisms and configuration protection, FAQs, etc., see [README-advanced.md](https://github.com/developer-wlj/Windows-MoviePilot/blob/HEAD/README-advanced.md)

## Features

- **Fool-proof Visualization**: All operations require only button clicks, no command line knowledge needed
- **Zero Manual Environment Configuration**: nginx / Git / Python / uv portable versions automatically downloaded and installed, isolated from system environment
- **Automatic Media Component Downloads**: Automatically detects system fpcalc (audio fingerprint) and FFmpeg, automatically downloads portable versions if missing, uses system version if already installed
- **Automatic Virtual Environment Creation**: Backend runs in isolated venv, dependency isolation, can be rebuilt anytime
- **Automatic Updates and Patches**: Automatically checks for latest official version when restarting service, automatically applies v3-rebase patches (idempotent, skips if already applied)
- **Resource Synchronization to Prevent Missed Updates**: During updates, defaults to force re-download frontend resources and backend authentication/site resources, official re-releases of same version number won't be missed
- **GitHub Acceleration Friendly**: Supports Token and proxy (defaults to automatically follow Windows system proxy, can also manually specify http proxy; affects downloads and git)
- **System Tray Resident**: Minimize to tray, status at a glance; supports one-click service pull-up after system startup
- **Graceful Shutdown**: Gracefully sends shutdown signal and waits for task completion on stop, force-terminates after timeout, balances data safety and response speed
- **Auto-cleanup on System Shutdown**: Automatically intercepts during Windows shutdown/restart and gracefully stops services, terminates residual child processes before proceeding, prevents service data corruption
- **Tray Left-click Toggle**: Left-click tray icon to toggle main window visibility/hidden (right-click for menu), more convenient operation
- **Prevent System Sleep**: Can enable blocking Windows idle sleep/suspend to ensure uninterrupted long downloads and task execution
- **Dual-Version Backend**: Supports standard and freethreaded (Python free-threaded) backend environments, independently isolated, one-click switching

# epub-handbook

Chinese EPUB 3 creation, cleaning, and compatibility toolkit.

If you just want to create a book, fix an existing EPUB, or troubleshoot a specific issue, choose one of the three paths below.

The unified CLI entry point is `epub` (run with `go run ./cmd/epub` in the repository, or use it directly after `go build -o epub ./cmd/epub`).
`epub capabilities --json` lists all capabilities; add `--id <capability-id>` to view only that capability's parameters, default values, and execution form.
`epub run ... --json` and `epub redline --json` return a unified JSON envelope; `epub capabilities --json` returns a capabilities array. Exit codes 0/1/2/3
(0 success; 1 failure or error-level findings; 2 requires human approval; 3 usage error).

In releases, `epub.style.demo.maintain catalog=true` can use embedded catalogs offline; `epub.style.demo.maintain --input <book.epub>` requires repository checkout or setting `EPUB_HANDBOOK_ROOT` to point to the repository root.

As of 2026-09-27, the current release version is [`v0.4.2`](https://github.com/liyafly/epub-handbook/releases/tag/v0.4.2); attachments contain Linux amd64, Windows amd64, macOS arm64, and macOS amd64 binaries, installation instructions, and `SHA256SUMS`. metasequoiaime/msime.body:
# Metasequoia IME

Metasequoia IME (MSIME) is a multi-platform Chinese input method for Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and HarmonyOS. Each of the six platforms has its own native input method host; all connect to the same shared input runtime and the same React settings interface; the React management interface calls general Rust business libraries through Tauri; the input algorithm is provided by msime-engine.

Project homepage: [msime.app](https://msime.app/) · [GitHub repository](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime) · [Contributors](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/graphs/contributors) · [Report issues](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/issues)

## Star History

> **About the name**: MSIME is short for Metasequoia IME (Metasequoia Input Method), unrelated to Microsoft IME and has no association with Microsoft. The `msime` in code, package names, and repository names all have this meaning. The `shuangpin_profile: microsoft` in settings is the "Microsoft Shuangpin" scheme, one of four key layout schemes alongside Xiaohong, Ziran, and Shoudo, for users accustomed to that layout, and similarly represents no association.

**The input method can see everything you type, so this question should have an item-by-item verifiable answer: [what data leaves the device](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md).** Short version: Under the default configuration, only cloud prediction—one feature—sends the Pinyin being composed (to Google Input Tools; can be disabled); other online features require you to provide credentials. Additionally, there is one telemetry report that does not carry input content: macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and HarmonyOS send an installation count to `api.msime.app` once at startup; among these, all except HarmonyOS also send exception information on crash, enabled by default with no switch currently; on Windows, this same report is disabled by default and requires enabling "Anonymous Usage Statistics" in Settings > About to send—fields, per-platform differences, and storage locations are listed item-by-item in [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md#安装与崩溃上报). The repository does not integrate any third-party statistics or crash reporting SDKs.

## Module Boundaries

- `crates/client-core`: Host-agnostic client business logic—local configuration, fixed resource generational installation, account and session, cloud and AI, skins, dictionary, clipboard, voice, translation, typing statistics; does not depend on Tauri, UI, or platform hosts.

All-in-one Jav & Emby management platform for 115 Cloud Storage.

Miyabi supports direct integration with 115 for scraping and subscription, and can also serve as a backend service to support Emby.

## Project Preview

## Docker Deployment

> [!TIP]
> You can use AI to assist with project deployment. If accessing from the public internet, please pay attention to network security.

Public image:

```text
ghcr.io/ppxb/miyabi
```

### 1. Running with Docker CLI

Please replace `/path/to/data` with the data persistence directory on your host, and replace `change-this-password` with your custom password:

```bash
docker run -d \
  --name miyabi \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --security-opt no-new-privileges:true \
  -p 8080:8080 \
  -v /path/to/data:/app/data \
  -e MIYABI_ACCESS_PASSWORD='change-this-password' \
  -e MIYABI_PUBLIC_URL='http://<Host IP>:8080' \
  ghcr.io/ppxb/miyabi:latest
```

> [!NOTE]
> If used with Emby, the generated STRM playback links and metadata are output by default in `/app/data/emby` (corresponding to the host directory `/path/to/data/emby`). You can mount this directory to the Emby container as a media library.

### 2. Using Docker Compose (Recommended)

Create a `docker-compose.yml` file:

```yaml
services:
  miyabi:
    image: ghcr.io/ppxb/miyabi:latest
    container_name: miyabi
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - /path/to/data:/app/data
    environment:
      - MIYABI_ACCESS_PASSWORD=change-this-password
      - MIYABI_PUBLIC_URL=http://<Host IP>:8080
      # Optional: Preset Emby integration directly via environment variables (can also be configured in the Web settings page after startup)

```

A lightweight live stream status monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms, and automatically sends notifications through multiple channels (Bark / Server酱 / WeChat for Work / PushPlus / Telegram) when broadcasts start or new works are published.

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-Platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin live streams simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-Channel Notifications**: Send notifications through Bark / Server酱 / WeChat for Work / PushPlus / Telegram when broadcasts start or new works are published
- 📊 **Live Stream Duration Statistics**: Track broadcast duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **History Logs**: Keep the most recent 200 status change records

- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Works Detection**: Support for detecting new Douyin work publications (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitored Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file and add the broadcasters you want to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }

```

**Field Descriptions:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live stream room ID
  - Bilibili: Live room number (the number in the URL, e.g., `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Live room web_rid (the string in the URL, e.g., `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Broadcaster name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Broadcast/new work notifications support multiple channels, configured through the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/your_key", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or WeChat for Work group bot (free unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or…
```

sleep2agi/agent-network.body:
Agent Network

Let Claude, Codex and Grok form an AI team that can assign tasks to each other.

Local first · Multiple models · MCP + SSE · Apache 2.0

## Quick Start Requires Node.js ≥ 22.13. ```bash npm install -g bun @sleep2agi/agent-network @sleep2agi/agent-node # Terminal 1 anet hub start # Terminal 2 anet hub dashboard # Terminal 3 anet login --hub http://127.0.0.1:9200 --username admin anet node create my-bot anet node start my-bot ``` Verify the Hub is running: `curl http://127.0.0.1:9200/health` the returned JSON should contain `"ok":true`. > Is the node **really** running? See the criteria table at [Is this node alive](https://anet.sh/troubleshooting/is-this-node-alive). Open `http://localhost:3000`, assign tasks to the Agent from the Dashboard. Default admin username is `admin`, initial password is `anethub`. **Any public network deployment must run `anet passwd` immediately after login to change the password**, otherwise anyone who scans the port can access it. > See [Versioning](https://anet.sh/guide/versioning) for initial password differences across versions. ## What can it do - **Connect different Agents**: Claude Code, Claude Agent SDK, Codex, Grok Build can join the same network. - **Auto-discover and assign tasks**: Agents discover teammates through MCP, Hub distributes tasks in real-time through SSE. - **You control the data**: Hub, Dashboard and SQLite data run on your controlled machine. - **Preview channel extra capabilities**: `@preview` can also use **Codex TUI coexistence** and **OpenCode** (`codex-app-server` / `opencode-cli` two runtimes), see [Runtime page](https://anet.sh/guide/runtimes) for details. ```text Agent A ──task──▶ CommHub ──SSE──▶ Agent B… ```

yuzlyn/font-settings.body:
# Font Settings

- Author: **yuzlyn**
- Version: **v2.4.4**
- Module ID: `font-settings`

This is a universal KernelSU font module for Android 8.0+ that is not limited to specific phone brands or ROMs. The module provides an offline WebUI where you can upload multiple `.ttf` fonts for both Chinese and Western characters, arrange them in order to form a font-family fallback chain (missing characters automatically fall back, supports drag-and-drop sorting), adjust font weight from `100`–`900` after uploading variable fonts, and choose from built-in iOS, Google, Blobmoji, Facebook Emoji or upload custom `.ttf/.otf` fonts. All replacements take effect through KernelSU systemless mount, without directly modifying the system partition.

## Download

- Full package: [font-settings_v2.4.4_KSU.zip](https://github.com/yuzlyn/font-settings/releases/download/v2.4.4/font-settings_v2.4.4_KSU.zip), `179,036,143` bytes, SHA-256: `53D36A2D23E37E80C18B483D3B898C92E55677CA91A43DD29827757BC5C56FAC`.
- Lite package: [font-settings_v2.4.4_lite_KSU.zip](https://github.com/yuzlyn/font-settings/releases/download/v2.4.4/font-settings_v2.4.4_lite_KSU.zip), `33,315,416` bytes, SHA-256: `0DA1DC9B63C53051EFAC92A0E4AF6A9CB96F0EFEA21128F0FB1FB3A950F61462`; removes the four built-in Emoji sets from iOS, Google, Blobmoji, and Facebook, while still allowing you to keep the system default or upload custom Emoji.

v2.4.4 fixes the white screen issue when opening WebUI in the KernelSU manager. The root cause was that the interface script was loaded as an ES module (`<script type="module">`): KernelSU's static resource handler guesses MIME type based on **filenames with query strings** (`app.js?v=243` doesn't match any known extensions), falling back to `text/plain`, and ES modules are directly rejected by the browser when the MIME type doesn't match → white screen; the same file as a classic script executes normally (the old MDUI interface was a classic script, so this issue wasn't exposed before). Now the packaging has been changed to IIFE classic script (`--format=iife` + `<script defer>`), no longer dependent on the host's MIME type detection. Meanwhile, new WebUI features have been added…
